description: This organization's launches on Apptiller Launches: period, tier, proof, what would raise the tier, the latest numbers (revenue added in the period so far, growth, new customers, trials), and the public page's traffic over the last 7 days (views by where they came from, clicks out to the product, badge loads on other sites). For an app, app_store_from_launches: the App Store page views and first-time downloads Apple's App Analytics credits to apptiller.com (Web referrer) since the launch was made (since, a UTC day as App Analytics counts them), through latest, the last day Apple's reports reached. latest null: Apple's Detailed reports haven't both come in (started false: App Analytics not started; started true: still coming in). latest before since: Apple hasn't reported the launch's days yet, so the zeros aren't counts. stopped: every App Store Connect key that reads the app is revoked or broken, so latest won't move until it's replaced. Apple leaves small counts out. Each has its page in the web app. Withdrawing is done in the web app.
name: list_launches
title: Your launches
